Search summary: 142 km of slopes (44 km easy 31%, 66 km intermediate 46%, 32 km difficult 23%); 61 lifts with a total capacity of 96,281 persons/hour (skiresort.info lifts page, https://www.skiresort.info/ski-resort/mayrhofen-penken-ahorn-rastkogel-eggalm-mountopolis/test-result/lifts-cable-cars/). Counts by lift type were not given; named examples include the Penkenbahn, Horbergbahn and Ahornbahn gondolas, the Kombibahn Penken chair/gondola and the Babylift Penken T-bar.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate at the bases

character: The main ski area of the upper Zillertal, marketed as Mountopolis by the Mayrhofner Bergbahnen, spreads over the Penken, Horberg, Rastkogel and Eggalm sectors, with the separate Ahorn across the valley. It is covered by the Zillertal Superskipass, which includes the valley's other ski areas and the Hintertux Glacier.
learning: Reference note: the Ahorn plateau and parts of the Penken have gentle slopes and ski schools; confirm beginner areas and lesson products.
